body: Independent pre-acceptance review found three additional cases in attempt 2, handed to the worker for regression tests: viewport height growth during floor walking left feet at the old floor; moved ticket support validation allowed a center outside the card; and a jump from a ticket top could target floor directly below the same card. The worker is correcting these before submission. Sprite DM-126 is accepted after alpha, framing, contact-anchor and cross-action-scale checks.
